login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your email address and password, then choose the role you want to sign in as.
login.rejected: Those sign-in details were not accepted. Check the email address, the password and the selected role, then try again.
login.formErrors: Correct the following before signing in.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Enter the {{length}}-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
mfa.formErrors: Correct the following before submitting the code.
mfa.notEnrolled: Two-step verification is not set up
mfa.enrolmentUnknown: Whether two-step verification is set up could not be determined for this account.
mfa.enrolDescription: Scan the code with an authenticator app, then confirm it with a code from the app.
mfa.enrolReplacesNotice: Starting setup creates a new secret and replaces any authenticator entry you have already added.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for two-step verification. If you cannot use it, add the setup address shown below to your authenticator app by hand.
mfa.qrMissing: No QR code was returned. Use the setup address below instead.
mfa.provisioningUriMissing: No setup address was returned. Start setup again.
mfa.verifyDescription: Enter the {{length}}-digit code your authenticator app shows to finish setup.
mfa.verified: Two-step verification is confirmed for this account.
mfa.notVerified: That code was not confirmed. Wait for the next code in your authenticator app and try again.

account.description: Details of the account you are signed in with.
